title: 政治体制比较
text: 在学术研讨会中，学者们正深入探讨全球治理的多元模式。比较政治学旨在通过系统性分析，揭示不同政体在权力分配与运行机制上的本质差异。总统制强调行政首脑与立法机关的权力制衡，旨在防止权力过度集中。与之相对，议会制则通过内阁对议会的责任制，确保行政职能与立法意愿的高度统一。半总统制试图融合上述两者之长，构建一种双首长制的权力架构。这种制度安排在应对政治危机时展现出一定的灵活性，但亦容易引发行政内部的冲突。除了权力结构，政党体系的构成同样决定了政策制定的效率。多党制通过广泛的代表性促进社会共识，然而往往导致组阁困难。两党制则在竞争中强化政治极化，使得政策在两极之间剧烈摆动。法治原则在各类体系中均被视为核心，其核心在于限制公权力并保障公民基本权利。官僚体系的专业化程度直接影响政府执行力的强弱。某些国家采取精英治理模式，依靠高度选拔的文官群体维持稳定性。另一些国家则倾向于通过社会参与来增强决策的合法性。制度的有效性并非取决于其形式，而在于其与本土文化、历史传统是否相兼容。全球化进程促使各国在借鉴外部经验时，必须审慎评估制度移植的风险。缺乏社会基础的强行改造往往会导致严重的政治动荡。因此，深入研究制度演进的内在逻辑至关重要。通过量化分析与个案研究，我们可以更客观地评价不同治理方式的绩效。这种跨国界的学术对话有助于构建更合理的全球治理框架。最终目标是实现社会公平与行政效能的有机结合。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does the presidential system emphasize?
options: Power balance between the executive head and the legislature, to prevent excessive concentration of power
Complete merger of the executive and legislative branches into one body
Elimination of all legislative oversight of the executive
Direct rule by a single unelected leader

questions.prompt: How does the parliamentary system ensure unity between executive and legislative will, according to the text?
options: Through the cabinet's accountability (responsibility system) to parliament
By abolishing the legislature entirely
By having the executive appointed for life
By requiring unanimous public votes on every law

questions.prompt: What is a stated drawback of the multi-party system, according to the text?
options: It often makes forming a coalition government difficult
It always leads to civil war
It eliminates all political competition
It prevents any form of social consensus

questions.prompt: What does the text say determines whether a political system is effective?
options: Its compatibility with local culture and historical tradition, rather than its form
Whether it is a presidential or parliamentary system
The size of the country's population
How recently the system was established

questions.prompt: What warning does the text give about borrowing foreign institutional models?
options: Forced reform without a social foundation often leads to serious political turmoil
Borrowing foreign models always improves governance immediately
Only wealthy nations are capable of institutional borrowing
Institutional transplantation carries no risk if done quickly

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
